crossRefs.note: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”
He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.”…
Is anything too hard for Yahweh? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes round, and Sarah will have…
Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
By faith, even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted…

people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: For this is a word of promise, “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”
translations.bsb: For this is what the promise stated: “At the appointed time I will return, and Sarah will have a son.”
translations.kjv: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.
translations.asv: For this is a word of promise, According to this season will I come, and Sarah shall have a son.
